name: Gelse (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gelse: a blue and green shield with a white dove and a wavy stripe, between vine and grain branches, above a yellow scroll inscribed GELSE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gelse arms with branches and scroll
